deflection_zh: 這件事讓你害怕嗎？請告訴爸爸媽媽一起聊聊。

5-6: 先問：你聽到什麼？心裡有什麼感覺？
告訴孩子：現在我們是安全的，有大人在
不要把畫面說太細，簡單說就好
用地圖指給孩子看，那裡離我們很遠
7-8: 說明壞事很少發生，大人正努力處理
不要貼「壞人」標籤，說明事情的原因
鼓勵孩子用畫畫或玩遊戲表達感受
一起做一件能幫助別人的小事

what_not_to_say: 不要說「不要怕，這沒什麼」
不要讓孩子自己一個人看新聞畫面
不要說「壞人會來抓你」之類嚇唬的話

sources.title: Parenting Resources, Activities, & Early Childhood Development Support - Sesame Workshop

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: Does that make you scared? Please tell mom or dad, and talk together.

5-6: First ask: what did you hear? How did it make you feel?
Tell your child: we are safe now, and grown-ups are here.
Don't describe the pictures in detail; keep it short and simple.
Show on a map where it is, far away from where we live.
7-8: Explain that bad things rarely happen, and grown-ups are working to stop them.
Don't label people as 'bad guys'; explain what caused the problem.
Encourage drawing or play to express feelings.
Do one small helpful thing for someone together.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'don't be scared, it's nothing'.
Don't let your child watch news pictures alone.
Don't say 'bad guys will come and take you' or other scary threats.
